tagline: Compare roofline & guttering quotes from trusted UK installers
subTagline: Free, no-obligation quotes from vetted fascia, soffit and guttering specialists - fast and unbiased, no cold calls.
disclosureText: Orrell Roofline is an independent quote comparison service. We do not carry out installation work ourselves - we connect homeowners with vetted, independently-operated local roofline specialists.
_contentNotice: INTERNAL NOTE, not rendered on the site: testimonials are illustrative examples for design preview, and pricing/guarantee/vetting-criteria claims are based on typical UK market-rate reference data (roofline-industry norms), not confirmed facts about this specific business. reassurance.title: Genuinely independent
reassurance.text: We're not tied to any installer. We don't own a roofline brand, we don't push one product over another - our only interest is matching you with a good local job.

reassurance.title: Vetted network only
reassurance.text: Every installer is checked for Trading Standards / TrustMark registration where applicable, public liability insurance and independent reviews before they see a single lead.

reassurance.title: Insurance-backed guarantees
reassurance.text: All matched quotes include an insurance-backed 10-year guarantee on labour and materials - covered even if the installer stops trading.

reassurance.title: No cold calls, no data resale
reassurance.text: Your details go to the 2-3 installers we match you with, once. We never share, sell or reuse them beyond that quote.

testimonials.name: Jack T.
testimonials.quote: Three quotes for fascia and gutters within 48 hours, all local firms. Picked the one that could start soonest and get the anthracite grey I wanted.

testimonials.name: Rachel B.
testimonials.quote: Had a leaking gutter and one quote wanted to replace the whole run. Comparing let me spot the firm that could do a partial repair for a fraction of the price.

testimonials.name: Marcus A.
testimonials.quote: Replaced the fascia and soffit on a 1930s semi - the winning quote came in £600 under the first one I got directly from a national brand. Same materials, better guarantee.

faq.question: How much does new fascia and soffit cost?
faq.answer: As a guide based on typical UK market rates, replacing the full fascia and soffit run on an average 3-bed semi runs from around £900 to £2,400 fitted, depending on whether it's uPVC or aluminium, the roof line length, and whether the old timber needs full removal. Compare free quotes to get an exact figure for your property.

faq.question: Is this service really free?
faq.answer: Yes, comparing quotes through us is completely free for homeowners. We're funded by a referral fee paid by installers when they receive a quote request, which keeps quotes unbiased since there's no incentive to push one installer over another.

faq.question: Are your roofline installers vetted?
faq.answer: We only accept installers who meet our vetting criteria into our network - checks include Trading Standards / TrustMark registration where applicable, public liability insurance, evidence of insurance-backed guarantees on labour and materials, and independent reviews on at least one third-party platform.
